content: Human-labeling session — def-walls-vs-towers:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, your Construction Yard spawns at (10,14) NORTH or (10,26) SOUTH by seed, with a Barracks and two Power Plants on a fully OPEN arena (no terrain channels). You have $3000 and the Defense queue (cost reference: pillbox 600cr active anti- infantry turret; concrete wall 200cr passive obstacle, HP 40000, no weapon). TWO simultaneous waves arrive from the east mid-episode: a HEAVY horde on the same latitude as your yard (twelve attackers) AND a separate heavy wave on the opposite latitude (twelve attackers) that will detour to your yard across the y=20 midline. Win bar: at least two pillboxes AND at least six walls BUILT, ten kills, yard standing, within about sixty turns.
